items.name: Meet-Me Room
items.depicts: A large framed switchboard panel with a blue header bar and four vertical light-blue bays, each topped by a dark bezel with an animated green status light on the leftmost unit.

items.name: Route Flap Board
items.depicts: A dark-framed card displaying a blue header block, a dark label bar, a gray rule, and an animated green-and-amber segmented bar along the bottom.
items.concept: BGP routing tables and prefix announcements

items.name: Abyssal Trunkline
items.depicts: A horizontal two-tone blue-and-navy conduit banded at regular intervals by four amber collars, resembling an armored undersea cable.

items.name: Resolver Ledger
items.depicts: A white index card with a green header strip, a navy drop shadow, and three horizontal bars representing resolved record fields.

items.name: Autonomous Cloud
items.depicts: A white pixelated cloud with a blue rectangular badge across its center and a pale blue shadow beneath it.

items.name: Glass Filament
items.depicts: A thin horizontal cyan optical line with a bright white light pulse traveling at its right tip.

items.name: Default Gateway
items.depicts: A dark navy box with a cream front panel, four alternating amber and green LEDs, and two upright dark gray antennas.

items.name: Uplink Dish
items.depicts: A dark gray pedestal supporting a tilted pale-blue parabolic dish with a darker blue feed horn angled toward the lower right.

items.name: Best-Effort Datagram
items.depicts: A white envelope-like card with a cyan top header bar, a navy drop shadow, a gray address line, and an amber square payload block.

items.name: Trust Anchor
items.depicts: A closed green padlock with a lighter green shackle and a vertical white keyhole slot in the center.

items.name: RFC 1149 Carrier
items.depicts: A tiny white flying bird with a blue head and beak and a two-pixel cyan contrail trailing behind it.

items.name: Ping Probe
items.depicts: A tiny floating white probe with two blue top-mounted panels and a single green beacon pixel underneath.
items.concept: network probe and orbital relay satellite
